source_name: DuaPune.com — employer pages (KCGF and public institutions)
why_relevant: Second major Kosovo job board with per-employer archives. Provides a historical series of a given institution's vacancies, useful for reconstructing hiring trends when the institution's own site does not archive expired konkurse.

source_name: Prishtina Online — procurement notice mirror for central institutions
why_relevant: Mirrors B05/B08 procurement notices from central Kosovo institutions as static PDFs, indexed by search engines. Because e-Prokurimi's own notice pages are hard to crawl, this mirror is a practical discovery surface for award notices naming suppliers.

source_name: Posta e Kosovës — public competitions and procurement (finance/treasury roles)
why_relevant: A publicly owned enterprise that publishes its konkurse in both Albanian and Serbian (e.g. 'Javni Konkurs' for Chief Director of Finance and Treasury) and its own contract-award notices. Relevant as a state-owned payments-adjacent employer and as one of the few reliable sr-language public vacancy sources in Kosovo.

source_name: GAP Institute — public procurement analyses
why_relevant: Think tank producing analytical reports on Kosovo public procurement, including at publicly owned enterprises. Useful for interpreting KRPP data, identifying systematic irregularities and locating datasets/methods, and as a pointer to further sources.

source_name: KALLXO.com — investigative coverage of procurement and public appointments
why_relevant: Investigative outlet with dedicated tags for KRPP and for financial-institution appointments; reported, for instance, the failed Assembly vote on a third BQK board member and the re-run competition. Fastest human-readable signal on contested appointments and problematic tenders, with named individuals.

source_name: TenderScope — commercial aggregator of KRPP/SPIN notices
why_relevant: Third-party service that aggregates Kosovo KRPP notices with filtering by contracting authority, CPV, value and deadline — capabilities the official portal exposes poorly. Potential shortcut for CPV-based monitoring of banking/payment-services tenders, subject to licensing.

source_name: Open Contracting Partnership — Kosovo procurement data assessment
why_relevant: Documents exactly what structured data Kosovo's procurement platform exposes (procurement plans, tender dossiers, signed contract PDFs, contract implementation cards, bidder/buyer/supplier/value fields, 31,000+ tender records) and where coverage is weak. Essentially a specification for building an automated collector against e-Prokurimi.

source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU Official Journal supplement), advanced search filtered to Kosovo / financial-sector TA
why_relevant: Mandatory publication venue for EU-funded external-action service contracts, including IPA technical assistance to Kosovo's Central Bank, Ministry of Finance and payment-system reform. Notices name the contracting authority, the TA lot, and often key-expert profiles (KE1 banking supervision, KE2 payments), which reveal both external expert hiring and the institutional reorganisations the TA supports. Contract-award notices name the winning consortium, which is the pointer to who will actually staff the assignment.

source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal (external action / IPA calls, incl. Kosovo)
why_relevant: Companion venue to TED for EU service contracts and grants; carries the terms of reference documents where key-expert job descriptions for Kosovo financial-sector TA are spelled out in detail.

source_name: EBRD Client eProcurement Portal (ECEPP) — consultancy and project notices, Kosovo
why_relevant: EBRD publishes every consultancy assignment notice here; Kosovo notices confirmed live in search results (e.g. PIU support consultant assignments). EBRD's Kosovo work touches bank advisory, SME lending lines and financial-institution capacity building, so notices flag advisory experts placed inside Kosovo banks and the reform agendas they support.

source_name: EBRD procurement notices hub (ebrd.com)
why_relevant: Entry point that routes to ECEPP and to corporate consultancy opportunities; useful for discovering which EBRD programmes are active in Kosovo and thus which counterpart banks are being advised.

source_name: World Bank Projects & Operations — Kosovo project and procurement detail pages
why_relevant: Project pages carry procurement plans (via STEP) listing consultancy packages, and appraisal documents that describe institutional reorganisation of Kosovo counterparts (CBK, Treasury, payment systems). Search returned live Kosovo procurement-detail and project-detail URLs, confirming the pattern.

source_name: World Bank Documents & Reports — Kosovo procurement plans and project appraisal documents
why_relevant: Procurement plans published here list individual-consultant and firm assignments line by line, with estimated values and review status; PADs describe planned PIU staffing and counterpart-institution restructuring. Confirmed Kosovo procurement-plan text files exist on documents1.worldbank.org.

source_name: IFC career and consultant opportunities / IFC Kosovo advisory programmes
why_relevant: IFC advisory services in the Western Balkans cover bank risk management, NPL resolution and digital financial services; postings and short-term-consultant calls reveal which Kosovo banks are counterparts and what functions are being built.

source_name: GIZ Kosovo country page and vacancy channel (application.kosovo@giz.de)
why_relevant: GIZ has worked in Kosovo since 1999 with economy/private-sector and public-finance programmes; its advisor vacancies (confirmed pattern: 'Advisor on Financial Sector Development and Reform' role type exists at GIZ) name programme, counterpart institution and technical function, exposing donor-side hiring into financial-sector reform.

source_name: PrishtinaOnline — Konkurset (Albanian vacancy listings)
why_relevant: Long-running Albanian listings page used by institutions and projects; low-tech and easy to archive, good for historical continuity of donor-project vacancy announcements.

source_name: EEAS — EU Office in Kosovo / EUSR (delegation site, incl. Section for Finance, Contracts and Audit)
why_relevant: The contracting authority for EU-funded TA in Kosovo. Publishes local calls, contract announcements and project launches in en/sq/sr; its finance-contracts section (delegation-kosovo-fincon@eeas.europa.eu) is the origin point for the notices that later appear on TED.

source_name: WBIF — Western Balkans Investment Framework, procurements and opportunities
why_relevant: WBIF blends EU grants with EBRD/EIB/KfW/CEB finance across the Western Balkans including Kosovo; its procurement page lists TA assignments and consultant opportunities that sit upstream of institutional reform work, and its project sheets name lead IFIs and beneficiary institutions.

source_name: EIB — Kosovo country page and EIB procurement
why_relevant: EIB operates in Kosovo under a 2013 Framework Agreement, largely infrastructure but with intermediated lending through local banks; project and procurement pages identify partner banks and any accompanying TA, an indirect indicator of bank-side capacity building and staffing.

source_name: KfW Development Bank — Kosovo office and financial-sector programmes
why_relevant: KfW has a long history in Kosovo's financial sector (microfinance/bank refinancing lines documented since the 2000s); its Kosovo office and consultant procurement identify partner financial institutions and the advisory firms placed with them.

source_name: Devex — jobs and organisation profiles for Kosovo banking/financial-sector consultancies
why_relevant: Aggregates donor/IFI consultant calls with rich role detail (e.g. 'Consultant: Banking Supervision/Consumer Protection Expert', 'International Banking and Financial Services Regulatory Expert') and maintains organisation profiles for Kosovo banks (NLB Banka Kosovo, Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo, American Bank of Kosovo) including senior-role postings such as CEO. Strong for leadership-moves signals.

source_name: DevelopmentAid — donor tender and organisation database (Kosovo financial sector)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that indexes donor tenders, awards and expert calls across EBRD/WB/EU/KfW for Kosovo; useful as a discovery layer to identify implementing firms and named experts, then verify at the primary source.

source_name: UNDP Kosovo careers / UN Kosovo team jobs page
why_relevant: UNDP and the UN Kosovo Team recruit project associates, finance officers and policy/finance advisors attached to public-finance and economic-governance projects; postings name the project and counterpart ministry, exposing where reform capacity is being added.

source_name: Swiss Cooperation Office Kosovo (SDC / eda.admin.ch) and implementing partners (Swisscontact, Helvetas)
why_relevant: SDC funds Kosovo economic-development and employment programmes implemented by Swisscontact and Helvetas; their project pages and vacancies show donor-side hiring and which financial/economic institutions are counterparts. Financial-sector focus is weaker than EU/EBRD/WB but still relevant to organisation-change signals.

source_name: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo — Tenderët (procurement announcements)
why_relevant: The CBK is the beneficiary institution for most donor/IFI payments-and-supervision TA. Its own tender page (Albanian) shows which advisory, IT and payment-system services it is buying — the domestic mirror of the international notices, and a leading indicator of internal reorganisation.

source_name: e-Prokurimi — Kosovo Public Procurement Regulatory Commission e-procurement platform
why_relevant: National e-procurement platform where donor-cofinanced and government contracts (including CBK/Ministry of Finance advisory and payment-system contracts) must be advertised; the domestic counterpart to TED and the place where implementing consortia and awarded values appear in Albanian and Serbian.

source_name: SCAAK — Society of Certified Accountants and Auditors of Kosovo, Konkurse page
why_relevant: Professional body whose vacancy page carries donor-project and financial-institution roles requiring audit/finance credentials; a good local-language capture point for project-financed finance and compliance hires.
